summary: Work log rows lead with their toggle, align Running with durations and share the Working spinner; the conversation header drops its run status and progress sweep

replay.detail: Web UI presentation only; no replay or rebuild.

compatibility.detail: No runtime, wire or client changes. The kit adds a LiveRing export. The transcript window constants move to their own module and stay exported from @fractal/ui/assistant-ui, and the durationColumn token is retained.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous row layout and header status.
